open.thesis: Split out of the validator-drift thesis, which was closed today on its validator half. RUNBOOK.md KNOWN LIMITATIONS still reads 'seasonProj is assumed live, not proven ... if two snapshots days apart show identical numbers, it is a preseason artifact.' That is settled and settled the other way: chem-seasonproj-live-2026-09-21 proved the field recomputes after each slate by diffing two commits, 245 of 250 season projections changed. A run that follows the runbook literally here will under-trust a live field. The REAL limitation, observed again today, is different and narrower: seasonProj does not price AVAILABILITY. Josh Jacobs reads 167.6 on the commissioner's exempt list; Jaxson Dart reads 238.5 in IPADE and 256.2 in Chem with a possibly season-ending knee; meanwhile Pacheco, Tank Dell and Stribling are correctly zeroed, so the behaviour is inconsistent rather than frozen. || [16 earlier review notes folded 2026-11-15; outcomes preserved in the closed list] || REVIEWED 2026-11-14T22:25:00Z (Saturday 16:00 CDMX run, 22:05Z snapshot): UNRESOLVED.
